translation_notes: the region constructs no RDF term and no triple - it parses a TriG document from the test suite and compares a URI to a Python string - so translated.ldpy is the original with only an explanatory comment added; no island appears

no @prefix declared: the DC/RDF/DCTERMS/PROV/XSD namespaces imported by the enclosing test module are unused in the region (the draft declared all five, and injected them in the middle of the `from nanopub import (` statement, which does not even parse)

the nanopub package is not installed in the evaluation venv; driver.py appends the corpus checkout to sys.path (appended, so the example's own shims keep priority). All its runtime dependencies are already present in the venv

context shim: nanopub_testsuite_connector.py is an offline stand-in for the nanopub-testsuite-connector package, whose NanopubTestSuite.get_latest() downloads the suite from GitHub; the driver builds the `testsuite` fixture from it. Identical for both sides

vendored data: testsuite/valid/trusty/example3.trig, the entry the real get_by_nanopub_uri(...) returns for RA1sViVmXf-W2aZW4Qk74KTaiD9gpLBPe2LhMsinHKKz8, from nanopub-testsuite (MIT, see testsuite/LICENSE)
equivalence evidence is the test's own assertion (both sides parse the trusty nanopub and read the same source URI back); the region returns None, so the harness has no other value to compare
